steps.path: Last night's AirPlay handoff session, replayed exactly
steps.headline: Three separate tool bubbles, an empty bubble and a lone “Interrupted.” collapse into two bubbles, one per step.
steps.changed: Some models (DeepSeek here) send blank newline chunks between and after the tool calls they make. The app treated every blank chunk as the start of a new message, so each one opened a fresh bubble. Blank chunks that do not belong to a paragraph are now ignored; blank lines inside a paragraph still work.
steps.measured: 7 bubbles before, 2 after, for the same conversation
steps.notice: Tools called in the same step stack inside one bubble as a collapsed group (“3 tools — all complete”), and the “Interrupted.” note sits under the bubble that was cut off. Two tools called back-to-back with nothing said between them also share one group, so the Write and the failed Grep read as “2 tools — 1 failed” until expanded.
steps.risk: The pictures replay the real session with the reasoning and prose shortened. “Read ×2” is genuine: the model read the same file twice.

steps.path: A turn that opens with a tool that needs your permission
steps.headline: A tool waiting for your permission no longer leaves an empty bubble above its Yes / No card.
steps.changed: The permission card is pinned to the bottom of the chat, but the bubble that would have held the tool stayed on screen as an empty shell with only a timestamp. A bubble that has nothing to show is skipped now.
steps.notice: Nothing sits above the permission card until you answer. Once you do, the tool card appears in its bubble exactly as before.
steps.risk: The bubble now appears at the moment you answer instead of being there already, a small pop-in.

steps.headline: Starting a turn with a skill no longer leaves a thin empty bubble above the reply.
steps.changed: The “Invoked skill” card always shows at the end of the reply, but the bubble it originally belonged to stayed behind as an empty sliver. That sliver is gone.
steps.notice: The reply moves up by one sliver; the skill card is where it was.
steps.risk: None seen. The reply is otherwise unchanged.
